title: LinkedIn Posts Search Scraper Input Schema

keyword.title: Search keyword
keyword.description: Keyword or phrase to search for, exactly as you would type it into the LinkedIn search bar.

sort_type.title: Sort type
sort_type.description: How LinkedIn should sort the search results: most relevant posts or the most recent ones.

date_filter.title: Date filter
date_filter.description: Only return posts published within the selected period.

total_posts.title: Total posts to scrape
total_posts.description: How many posts to collect in total. Pagination is handled automatically until this number is reached or LinkedIn runs out of results.

page_number.title: Page number
page_number.description: Page to start from, for manual pagination. Each page returns up to 50 posts: page 1 covers posts 1-50, page 2 covers 51-100, and so on.

company_urns.sectionDescription: Optional filters narrowing down which posts and authors are returned. URNs are LinkedIn's numeric identifiers; extract them from a LinkedIn search URL (e.g. fromOrganization=%5B%221441%22%5D decodes to 1441).
company_urns.title: From companies (URNs)
company_urns.description: Comma-separated list of company URNs. Only posts published by these companies are returned, e.g. "1441,1035" for Google and Microsoft.

author_company_urns.title: Author's companies (URNs)
author_company_urns.description: Comma-separated list of company URNs. Only posts written by authors working at these companies are returned, e.g. "1035,1045" for Microsoft and Apple.

author_industry_urns.title: Author's industries (URNs)
author_industry_urns.description: Comma-separated list of industry URNs. Only posts written by authors working in these industries are returned, e.g. "43,4" for Financial Services and Software Development.

author_job_title.title: Author's job title
author_job_title.description: Only posts written by authors with this job title are returned, e.g. "software engineer".

proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Defaults to Apify's plan-included datacenter proxies, rotated aggressively to keep cost down. If you hit frequent login walls, switch to the RESIDENTIAL group (extra cost) for higher success.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Select the proxies the scraper rotates through. Defaults to the cheap Apify datacenter pool; the actor relies on session rotation, cookie warmup and realistic headers to stay under the radar.
